description: Periodic conventional diamond-Si cell expanded 2x2x2 (64 Si) with one Li migrating between adjacent empty tetrahedral interstitial sites.
lattice_role: Initial guess, not a fixed author-optimized lattice constant. Optimize the conventional Si8 lattice before expansion and record the resulting lattice.
endpoint_definition: Symmetry-derived representatives of adjacent empty Td sites in the 2x2x2 conventional-cell supercell; not author-released Cartesian coordinates. Keep the same Si and Li atom mapping. The straight segment passes through the intervening hexagonal interstitial region.
multiplicity_instruction: Account for the valence charge of the selected PAW datasets. For an odd electron count the author protocol fixes N_up-N_down=1. Report the spin treatment for the even-electron added state explicitly.
units: angstrom for lattice; fractional coordinates for positions; energies in eV
